## Structs with architecture-specific layouts

The amd64 and arm64 layouts of these differ (directly, or through a by-value
field); each is emitted from its own metadata variant into `<pkg>_structs_amd64.go`
and `<pkg>_structs_arm64.go`, and its ABI assertions run per architecture.

- `CONTEXT`
- `DISPATCHER_CONTEXT`
- `KNONVOLATILE_CONTEXT_POINTERS`
- `MINIDUMP_CALLBACK_INPUT`
- `MINIDUMP_THREAD_CALLBACK`
- `MINIDUMP_THREAD_EX_CALLBACK`
- `SLIST_HEADER`
- `UNWIND_HISTORY_TABLE`
- `UNWIND_HISTORY_TABLE_ENTRY`
- `WER_RUNTIME_EXCEPTION_INFORMATION`
